pastDue.subject: Subscription past due: {organization}
pastDue.body: The subscription of {organization} is past due: the paid period ended on {periodEnd} and no new payment has been recorded.
pastDue.nextStep: Without a recorded payment, the subscription will be suspended on {date}; the customer will then have read-only access.
pastDue.nextStepUnknown: Without a recorded payment, the subscription may be suspended.

suspended.subject: Subscription suspended: {organization}
suspended.body: The subscription of {organization} was suspended for lack of payment of the period that ended on {periodEnd}.
suspended.access: The customer keeps read and export access, without new changes. Recording the payment reactivates the subscription.

aiKeyBackup.subject: The AI key of {workspace} failed
aiKeyBackup.body: The AI key used by {agent} in {workspace} failed (invalid, revoked, out of credit or at the provider's limit). Meanwhile, the platform only finishes the conversations that were already open, with a courtesy model that does not count toward your usage. New conversations are not answered.
aiKeyBackup.nextStep: Replace or test the key by {date}; without a fix, the agent will be paused.

aiKeyPaused.subject: AI agent paused in {workspace}
aiKeyPaused.body: {agent} in {workspace} was paused because the AI key was not fixed within 24 hours.
aiKeyPaused.nextStep: The backup ended on {date}. Replace and test the key, then turn the agent back on.
